summary: Target the control node with localhost or 127.0.0.1, or define localhost in inventory with ansible_connection=local and an ansible_python_interpreter.
questions: How do I run Ansible against my own machine?
How do I set localhost to use a local connection?

answer_card.title: Run against localhost
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible localhost -m ping -e 'ansible_python_interpreter="/usr/bin/env python"'
```
Or add to inventory:
```text
localhost ansible_connection=local ansible_python_interpreter="/usr/bin/env python"
```
